alibabacloud-oss-static-website-diagnosis 0.0.1 – Initial Release

- Provides read-only diagnosis for OSS static website hosting configuration, homepage/404 rules, and "website opens as a download" issues.
- Enforces strict read-only operation: no mutating API calls or configuration changes, only evidence-based findings and guidance.
- Runs mandatory script-based diagnostics; never assembles ad-hoc OSS commands or accepts credentials directly.
- Cites only officially verified documentation from the script output, never fabricates or substitutes URLs.
- Only handles static website hosting issues as defined; other OSS topics are routed to sibling skills.
